General Health: Takes a daily multivitamin, omega-3 supplements for heart health, and probiotics for digestion. Since gallbladder was removed years ago, occasionally takes digestive enzymes when consuming heavier meals. Digestive system now requires more care with fatty foods due to altered bile flow. 

Medication Interactions: Aware of potential risks with NSAIDs and kidney function. Avoids frequent use of meloxicam due to concern with losartan(an ACE inhibitor). Also takes thyroid medication(levothyroxine) separately from calcium and iron supplements to prevent interference with absorption.
